nxdnPath.description: Path to the nxdn executable. Defaults to DOTNET_NX_NXDN or nxdn on PATH.

selectorTags.description: Structured metadata dimensions to project into namespaced Nx tags. Empty by default.

hostTarget.description: Target whose aggregate host requirement is projected when selectorTags includes host.

includeInferredHostSelectors.description: Allow advisory inferred host compatibility to become selector tags. Explicit host requirements are always eligible.
